# fixture data, never executed: the bound token only in comments; must read bounded=no
# SOLEUR_TEST_SUITE_PID != "$p" || exit 0
# [ "$p" -ne "$SOLEUR_TEST_SUITE_PID" ] && break
p=$1; top=""
while [ -r "/proc/$p/cmdline" ]; do
  top=$p; p=$(awk '{print $4}' "/proc/$p/stat")
done
[ -n "$top" ] && kill -TERM "$top"
